blocks.title: Turn a page Vetta built into a link you can send
blocks.description: Publish an HTML report, prototype or small static site to a public deed.page URL. No account or API key is needed to start.

showcase.user_prompt: Publish the summary page you just made so I can send it to the team, and make it expire in a week.
showcase.assistant_reply: I'll publish index.html to a deed.page URL with a seven-day expiry and send you the link. Keep the owner token from this publish private, or paste it into the connection settings, because anyone who has it can update or delete your sites.

blocks.title: What you can ask Vetta to do

items.title: Share a finished page
items.description: Publish one HTML file or a few files with their paths kept, and get the live URL back.

items.title: Revise in place
items.description: Update the same slug after edits, list your sites or restore an earlier version.

items.title: Take it down
items.description: Delete a site with its owner token, or set an expiry when you publish.

items.title: Install the connection
items.description: Leave the optional token field empty the first time.

items.title: Ask Vetta to publish
items.description: Say what to publish and, if you like, a slug or an expiry.

items.title: Keep the token
items.description: Save the owner token from the first publish privately, or paste it into the connection settings to reuse it.

blocks.title: Published pages are public
blocks.content: Anyone with the link can open a published page. Do not publish secrets or private data. Free sites have size and count limits and show a small deed.page link.

blocks.title: You confirm payments and public posts
blocks.content: A third-party payment or promotional link may appear while you use deed.page, for example an upgrade link when a Free plan limit is reached. Confirm any payment or public post yourself.
